munera-registry.description: Pull arena/mulib/ludus from the private vcpkg registry (see vcpkg-configuration.json) instead of building the local ../Munera source. Enable together with -DMUNERA_FROM_REGISTRY=ON. Off by default so local-source builds never touch the registry. NOTE that the registry builds what was PUSHED: any local edit in ../Munera that has not been committed and had its port REF bumped simply does not exist in this mode, and the build will succeed without it.
